prompts: Pixel Arena, our Unreal game in {WS}, runs fine in the editor. In the packaged build, players say the arena has no colors, and the game crashes after a minute or so of play. The log of one packaged run is in {WS}/Saved/Logs. There is no engine on this machine, so you cannot build or run it. Find out why and fix the sources and the config. Record the causes in {WS}/result.json: crash_cause, no_colors_cause.
answers:
[goal] Find and fix why the packaged build loses colors and crashes after ~1 min.
[action] Read `Saved/Logs/PixelArena-shipping.log`, `Config/DefaultGame.ini`, and `Source/PixelArena/ArenaGameMode.{h,cpp}`. Added `+DirectoriesToAlwaysCook=(Path="/Game/Data/Palettes")` to the config; changed `ScoreTracker` to GC-rooted `TObjectPtr`, `Stats` to `TUniquePtr`, and guarded `OnGoalScored` against null/post-EndPlay state. Recorded causes in `result.json`.
[result] Two causes: palette package was never cooked (bCookAll=False + cook lists only cover `/Game/Maps/Arena` and `/Game/Data/Effects`), so `LoadObject` returned null and the HUD fell back to gray; and `UArenaScoreTracker* ScoreTracker` was a raw non-GC-rooted member, so after the first 412-object purge (`LogGarbage` at 21:05:13) the pointer dangled and `AddPoints()` read 0xffffffffffffffff (crash trace matches `ArenaScoreTracker.cpp:18` / `OnGoalScored`). Fixed both.
[next] Not verifiable on this machine (no engine, cannot cook/run). Caveats: missing sources (`ArenaScoreTracker.cpp/h`, `ArenaHud`, etc.) — the crash root cause is inferred from the log's timing (GC purge → goal → crash) and the non-rooted member pattern, not from reading the tracker code; the config fix assumes `/Game/Data/Palettes` is the right cook root for DA_Primary. Worth a packaged test build to confirm. No browser/desktop apps were opened.
